defects.problem: Screen recording crop is wrong for one frame: the top of the page is cut off and a fragment of a 'Zoom out' browser tab shows at the top-left, and the StreamFlix header and the page content sit lower/higher than in neighbouring frames. This is a visible layout jump and leaks recording chrome.
defects.fix: Drop or replace that frame with the held frame already used at 3.55s and 5.05s (same source), or trim the cut point so the 'Zoom out' frame is never shown.

defects.problem: The section opens on a dimmed, washed-out leftover of the previous scene (the 'Where do I press? There.' frame with a numbered badge and the Cancel button highlighted) before the real content. At feed size it reads as a mismatched flash, and the dissolve ghosts two different layouts.
defects.fix: Start the section on the clean 'Masked in your browser' frame, or make the dissolve shorter so no half-faded earlier frame shows in the sampled start.

defects.problem: The screenshot is soft and shows doubled outlines and jagged text (labels such as 'Card number', 'Billing phone', the Expiry/CVC row with a stray box edge). Next to the crisp final frame it looks like a low-resolution capture, and the card position differs by a few pixels from the final frame (about 124px vs 120px top), so the last cut shifts the layout slightly.
defects.fix: Use the sharper source for the masked frames, or scale it identically to the final frame so the card edges align when the screen changes to the upload view.

defects.problem: Three or four text tiers compete: big right-hand headline, highlighted bold line, sentence caption, and a small footnote. The right-hand headline repeats the highlighted line, and the right-top third of the frame is empty. The result feels crowded under the screen and unbalanced.
defects.fix: Remove one of the two repeated headlines (keep the highlighted line or the right-hand one) and give the screen the freed space with the same fixed layout.

defects.problem: At phone-feed size the screen contents, including the lock icons that explain the masking, are illegible. The footnote ('Synthetic screen. Third main recording...') is far too small to read, and the honest label is lost.
defects.fix: Raise the footnote size and weight, and make the highlighted line the one text anchor. Do not zoom the screen.

defects.problem: The cursor jumps from the top-left corner next to the StreamFlix logo into the Name on card field and then to the next position. This implies a purposeful action (hiding a missed field) that is not shown with a visible mask being drawn.
defects.fix: Hold the cursor still or cut to the frame where the extra mask is already applied.

defects.problem: The fade-out to the final masked frame ghosts the caption text and screen at the same time (about half opacity), which is a muddy mid-dissolve.
defects.fix: Shorten the dissolve or fade the caption separately from the screen.

couldNotAssess: Actual motion smoothness, easing, and cursor movement
Whether the zoom/jump at 4.55s lasts more than one frame
Contrast sensitivity under real feed compression
oneLineVerdict: Clear idea (masked in browser, then hide what it missed, then upload) with honest labels, but one cropped recording frame, a ghosted opening, soft capture and tiny feed-size text keep it near the rejected cut.
